ability.kegare.accelerate.desc: Toggle: your own clock runs %s times as fast, and everything you do with it: walking, sprinting and swimming, attacking, mining, eating, drinking, drawing a bow, loading a crossbow, raising a shield and your technique's other cooldowns. You keep full control; jumping and falling don't change. Costs Malice every second it's on.
ability.kegare.anchor.desc: First cast: throw an anchor that sticks where it lands (it lasts 20 seconds). Second cast: swap yourself with it.
ability.kegare.awareness.desc: Swap looks with the player you're looking at for 5 seconds: everyone else sees you as them and them as you (name, skin, armor, held items, tab list). Only looks change hands.
ability.kegare.chain_burst.desc: Every puppet of yours within 8 blocks of what you're looking at detonates, nearest first, one after another.
ability.kegare.curio_burst.desc: Detonate the puppet you're looking at. The more Malice it was made with, the bigger the blast: 4, 7 or 12 damage at the centre (half at the edge) and a push away. Never hurts you or your puppets.
ability.kegare.decelerate.desc: Throw a spinning clock hand. A hit deals %1$s damage and, for %2$s seconds, slows the target, slows their mining and runs their ability cooldowns at %3$s of their speed.
ability.kegare.directive.desc: Give every puppet within 32 blocks the next order: Follow, Stay, Guard (attack whoever damages you and whatever you damage, player or mob) or Go (walk to the block you're looking at, then stay). New puppets take the current order.
ability.kegare.exchange.desc: Give the player or mob you're looking at your worst negative effect and take their strongest positive one, duration and level included. Effects that last forever never move.
ability.kegare.fast_forward.desc: Take %s seconds off every other cooldown of your technique at once, never your ultimate's. Switches Accelerate off and starts their shared cooldown.
ability.kegare.focus.desc: Every puppet in range swarms the player or mob you're looking at, until it dies or gets away; then they go back to their order.
ability.kegare.frost_field.desc: While held, a freezing cone in front of you slows and adds 1 Freeze stack per second.
ability.kegare.frost_shard.desc: A fast ice shard: light damage, a short Slowness and 1 Freeze stack.
ability.kegare.glacial_lance.desc: Hold to charge (up to 2s), release to hurl a heavy lance. More charge, more damage; 2 Freeze stacks. A quick tap fizzles.
ability.kegare.glacial_spire.desc: Hold to charge (up to 2s) while aiming at the ground in range. A glowing crack rings the spot, then an ice spike erupts: damage, 2 Freeze stacks, and anyone on it is launched (higher with more charge).
ability.kegare.ice_path.desc: While held, slide fast the way you look over a trail of ice. Anyone else on the trail is slowed until it melts. Drains Malice while held.
ability.kegare.mimic.desc: Look like the player you're looking at for 8 seconds. They stay as themselves.
ability.kegare.momentum_exchange.desc: Swap velocity and fall distance with the player or mob you're looking at. Nobody moves; their momentum does.
ability.kegare.point_maker.desc: First cast: mark the top of the block you're looking at (up to %1$s blocks away; only you see it, and it lasts %2$s seconds). Second cast: return to it, facing as you did, shedding every effect you've gained since, healed by %3$s of your max health but never past the health you had when you marked it.
ability.kegare.positions.desc: Swap places and facing with the player or mob you're looking at (up to 24 blocks, in line of sight).
ability.kegare.possess.desc: Move into the puppet you're looking at (or your nearest one) and become it: its size, its health, no items, no casting. Your body stays behind, defenceless. R again returns. You snap back if your body is hit, if you go more than 64 blocks from it, or if the puppet dies (with backlash: nausea, a stun and lost Malice).
ability.kegare.puppet_creation.desc: Hold to charge, release to make a half-size puppet of yourself beside you. A tap (40 Malice) makes a weak one: 2 health, a faint glow. Half a charge (100) a steady one: 4 health. A full charge (180) a strong one: 8 health, a bright glow and an outline. Puppets last until killed; you can hold 15 at once.
ability.kegare.reinforced_fists.desc: Toggle: wrap your fists in Malice. Your melee hits deal %1$s more with an empty hand and %2$s more with anything in it, and a Reinforced Strike landed with it on hits again a moment later, for %3$s of its damage. Lighting it costs Malice, it drains more while it burns, and it stays lit outside Technique Mode.
Turn Malice back on your own body. Hold to heal, a little every tick, so damage heals as it lands; it keeps running at full health. How fast depends on your output, and injuries piling up in a fight drag it down. It drains Malice fast. Interrupted by stuns and freezing like any channel.
ability.kegare.reverse_malice_technique_: Heal the player you're looking at, within %1$s blocks, at %2$s of your own output, for %3$s times the Malice. Few can: it takes enough Output Insight, and then the right moment, when someone near you is badly hurt.
ability.kegare.rewind.desc: Snap the player or mob you're looking at (up to %1$s blocks) back to where it was %2$s seconds ago. Only its place goes back: health, effects and facing stay as they are.
ability.kegare.rime_shell.desc: Toggle a shell of ice: take less damage, and anyone who hits you up close is slowed.
ability.kegare.send_off.desc: Needs your anchor out: swap the player or mob you're looking at with the anchor instead of yourself. Uses the anchor up.
ability.kegare.shatter_shell.desc: Burst outward: everyone nearby is knocked back and gets 2 Freeze stacks. Uses up an active Rime Shell; costs more without one.
ability.kegare.splinter.desc: Three smaller shards in a fan. Each deals less damage and adds 1 Freeze stack; all three can hit one target.
ability.kegare.stand_in.desc: For 8 seconds one puppet (the one you look at, else your nearest) grows to your size and copies you: your moves, your held items and armor, your name. It looks exactly like you. Then it shrinks back.
ability.kegare.standstill.desc: Stop time for %1$s seconds within %2$s blocks of you. Everything else freezes: anything you throw hangs in the air, and every hit on the frozen lands at once when time resumes, as one blow. Anyone else with Time Manipulation moves too. Afterwards you're burnt out for %3$s seconds.
ability.kegare.stasis_field.desc: A field %1$s blocks round the block you're looking at, for %2$s seconds: everything inside is heavily slowed, and projectiles crawl through it at %3$s of their speed (yours too) until they're out.
ability.kegare.strings.desc: Fire a string at the player, mob or puppet you're looking at (up to 24 blocks). It holds for 8 seconds, or until stretched beyond 32 blocks. Press again to Reel In: pull it to you. Look at someone else and press to Tie them together: they're pulled into each other, collide, and stay within 3 blocks of each other for 4 seconds.
ability.kegare.switchback.desc: Swap places like Positions (player or mob), then swap back on your own after 3 seconds. Called off if either of you dies, logs out or leaves the dimension.
ability.kegare.test_aura.desc: Toggle a speed aura that drains Malice every second.
ability.kegare.test_blink.desc: Special of Dash: teleport a short way forward. Needs Aura switched on.
ability.kegare.test_burst.desc: Hold to charge, release to knock nearby creatures away.
ability.kegare.test_dash.desc: Launch forward in the direction you face.
ability.kegare.test_hover.desc: Hold to levitate. Drains Malice while held.
ability.kegare.test_shockwave.desc: A huge knockback wave around you.
ability.kegare.test_updraft.desc: Special of Hover: hold to charge, release to shoot straight up. Needs a rare trait.
ability.kegare.total_swap.desc: Everything at once with the player you're looking at (4+ blocks away): swap places and facing, look like each other for 5 seconds, and trade health as a share of max health.
ability.kegare.understudy.desc: Swap places with the puppet you're looking at (up to 32 blocks). Anything that blocks swaps blocks this too.
ability.kegare.zip_leash.desc: With a string attached: Zip pulls you to its target. Look at someone else to Leash: both stay within 6 blocks of you for 5 seconds, and you're slowed while they do. Leashed targets can still attack and cast.

ability_category.kegare.shared.desc: Abilities you unlock yourself. They're yours for good, through every reroll.

innate_technique.kegare.puppet_manipulat: Charge Malice into little copies of yourself. Command them, ride inside them, set them off, or let one stand in for you.
innate_technique.kegare.rime.desc: Malice made into ice: shards, a lance, a freezing gale and a shell of frost. Five Freeze stacks freeze a target solid. Cheaper in the cold, dearer in the heat.
innate_technique.kegare.swap.desc: Trade with whoever you're looking at: places, faces, fortunes and falls. Players always count; most of it works on mobs too.
innate_technique.kegare.test_apex.desc: Placeholder: every cast type in one, plus a shockwave ultimate.
innate_technique.kegare.test_flux.desc: Placeholder: lift and flow. Hover in place or run with a speed aura.
innate_technique.kegare.test_kinetic.des: Placeholder: raw motion. A dash and a charged knockback burst.
innate_technique.kegare.test_prism.desc: Placeholder: an Epic test card. Burst, hover and a shockwave ultimate.
innate_technique.kegare.time_manipulatio: Mark a moment to come back to, run your own clock fast and everyone else's slow, and at the last, stop time itself.
item.kegare.purification_talisman.desc: Rerolls your Innate Technique. Malice and traits are untouched.
